verdict.rationale: Consensus publishes its own machine-readable pricing page (/.well-known/pricing.md), which lists plan features such as Deep Searches and organization-level centralized billing. The MCP anonymous tier is described as rate-limited, giving a glimpse of usage limits. None of the cited excerpts show actual prices, plan tiers, or numeric quotas. Missing for 10: concrete plan prices, named tier comparison, numeric usage limits (e.g., searches per month), API/MCP rate-limit figures, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing
